name: Decks
description: Read and write decks, and drive the decks plugin on the person's screen: open a deck, move through it, present it, print it.

commands.name: decks_list_decks
commands.description: Every deck: id, collection, slug, title, subtitle and slide count. Use the id with the other deck tools.

commands.name: decks_get_deck
commands.description: One deck: its full spec and an outline (slide number, type, title) to find a slide before opening or changing it.

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

commands.name: decks_create_deck
commands.description: Create a deck from a complete spec under a short slug, optionally in a collection. The result names its id; the deck opens beside the conversation.

spec.description: The deck specification: `{deck: {title, subtitle?, template?}, slides: [...]}`.

collection.description: Optional family the deck belongs to.

commands.name: decks_update_deck
commands.description: Replace a deck's whole record — collection, slug and spec — by id. The same slug keeps the address.

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

spec.description: The deck specification: `{deck: {title, subtitle?, template?}, slides: [...]}`.

commands.name: decks_update_slide
commands.description: Replace one slide of a deck by its 1-based number, leaving the rest as they are.

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

slide.description: 1-based slide number, from the deck's outline.

commands.name: decks_insert_slide
commands.description: Insert a slide before the given 1-based position (past the end appends).

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

slide.description: 1-based slide number, from the deck's outline.

commands.name: decks_delete_slide
commands.description: Remove one slide of a deck by its 1-based number.

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

slide.description: 1-based slide number, from the deck's outline.

commands.name: decks_delete_deck
commands.description: Delete a deck by id. Irreversible; ask first.

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

commands.name: decks_list
commands.description: Close the open deck and show the list of decks.

commands.name: decks_open
commands.description: Open a deck by its id, optionally at a slide.

id.description: The deck id, `collection/slug` or `slug`, as listed by decks_list_decks.

slide.description: 1-based slide to open at. The first when omitted.

commands.name: decks_go_to_slide
commands.description: Move the open deck to a slide.

slide.description: 1-based slide number, from the deck's outline.

commands.name: decks_next_slide
commands.description: Advance the open deck by one slide.

commands.name: decks_previous_slide
commands.description: Go back one slide in the open deck.

commands.name: decks_present
commands.description: Put the open deck in fullscreen. Browsers only allow this from a person's click, so the result may say it was blocked — then ask them to press F or the Present button.

commands.name: decks_print
commands.description: Open the print view of the open deck in a new tab, for Save as PDF. The result carries the address in case the browser blocked the new tab.
